functionDeclarations.description:
Gateway model-service tool in the gateway MCP compatibility namespace. toolSummary is transport metadata only in this view.
Generate a new image or edit up to three attached reference images. Use only when a newly generated or edited image is the requested deliverable, not for analyzing attachments. Pass the relevant uploaded image paths in ImagePaths for editing or reference-guided generation; attachment IDs are also accepted when no path is provided. Call this tool alone, without other tools in the same response. The image is delivered automatically once. After the result, continue the task without repeating an image delivery receipt, paths or URLs in the visible answer; you may pass the returned artifact to a client tool when the task requires it.
